requirement: Settings › AI accounts draws the same vendor cards and connect panel as Getting started, with a Tracy AI card, a Default badge and a reorderable fallback list

oracle.invariant: With nothing connected the Tracy AI card carries the Default badge, its panel says it is the default, and the fallback block says there is no fallback yet. With two connections the cards carry Default / Connected / Included, the fallback list has one row per entry after the Default (Tracy AI included), and Move up sends PUT /api/seat-plan/routing with the swapped full order and the expected version. Set as default sends the full order with that id first; a refused reorder shows the server's sentence and keeps the old order. A key vendor's panel offers the password box; the pasted key goes to connect/key. AI accounts turned off by the operator: the note shows, the cards are inert, no panel, the fallbacks can be read but not moved.
oracle.productSourceGap: no product file is imported, read or run through a supported form in the command's test files (see tests/qa/layers/unit/lib/sources.mjs)

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)

assertionIds: badges: Default is the plain badge, Connected and Included the muted one, none when the caller says null
each panel state maps to the CSS state the stylesheet paints and carries a default icon
(a) nothing connected: Tracy AI is the Default, its panel says so, and there is no fallback yet
(b) two connections: badges Default / Connected / Included, the fallback rows, Move up on row 2 sends the swapped order with the version
a refused reorder shows the server’s sentence and keeps the old order
(d) a key vendor offers the password box, Connect and where to get a key; the pasted key goes to connect/key and the box clears
(e) AI accounts turned off: the note, the cards inert, no panel, the fallbacks to read but not to move
